Regarding your query, "I am still uncertain about whether the composition itself can be patented. From the date of filing of the provisional specification, there will be a time of 12 months to provide evidence of working, regarding the hypothesis made. Furthermore, the scope of the claim can be drafted based on the characterisation provided with a simulation/experiment details/empirical analysis. 

Based on this, please provide us your confirmation to proceed if your query is addressed."
